name: Clark Art Institute
notes: The Clark's campus in Williamstown: the 1955 Museum Building (Daniel Perry) as a white marble temple with its four-column portico to South Street; Pietro Belluschi's Manton Research Center (1973) behind it in red granite; Tadao Ando's Clark Center (2014), long and low with its granite wall, glass front and thin roof, northwest of the museum; the three-tiered reflecting pool (Ando with Reed Hilderbrand) stepping down toward the meadow; Selldorf's glazed link. From the Clark's own descriptions of its buildings and general knowledge; the OpenStreetMap ground had no buildings here, so the layout, sizes and heights are guessed, and the portico's orientation is a guess. The Lunder Center on Stone Hill is off the plate. No photographs were available.
